candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Pricing Analyst, Motor Insurance

## Experience

- Pricing analyst in the motor pricing team of a personal lines insurer for three years, refreshing the rating factors from the claims and quote data each quarter under the team's refresh procedure.
- Prepared eleven rate change proposals with their impact analysis; each was approved or amended by the pricing committee, with the committee's decision recorded on the proposal.
- Ran the pricing model monitoring each month and raised three drift cases to the actuarial team, recorded in the monitoring log.
- Prepared the monthly pricing pack for the pricing committee, recording in the pack which analyses were mine and which came from the actuarial team.
- Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each rate change proposal.

## Work samples

- Work sample: one rate change proposal with its impact analysis and the committee decision record, one monthly pricing pack and the monitoring log extract for the three drift cases, with the pricing repository references as a verification trail.
